paragraphs.text: 1)This report is to be done and tested by the programmers and system analysts of the group and 10 IT experts .

2) Fill out the details before starting the testing procedure . LIST ALL THE MODULES / FUNCTIONALITY OF YOUR SYSTEM, DELETE THOSE WHO ARE NOT INCLUDED IN YOUR SYSTEM. (YOU CAN ALSO GET THEM FROM YOUR MIDTERM PROGRESS REPORT IF AVAILABLE)
3. Record and document the testing specially when there are bugs or errors.
4) Functional Testing / Test Case or / Testing Plan (copy paste when you are done to your documentation Testing and Procedures)
5) When the testing is completed , errors are fixed then you can proceed to SYSTEM EVALUATION.

This technical testing report presents the procedures, test cases, results, identified defects, corrective actions, and overall assessment of the software system. The testing activities were conducted to determine whether the system meets its specified functional, technical, performance, security, usability, compatibility, and reliability requirements.
Verify that all major system functions operate according to specifications.
Identify defects, errors, and unexpected system behavior.
Evaluate system performance under defined conditions.
Verify compatibility across supported devices, browsers, and operating environments.
Assess system security and access-control mechanisms.
Verify database operations and data integrity.
Evaluate the system against applicable software quality standards.
Confirm that identified defects have been corrected and retested.
Determine whether the software is ready for deployment or user evaluation.

The following were excluded from the current testing cycle:
The testing process followed a structured testing approach consisting of:
Requirements → Test Planning → Test Case Development → Test Execution → Defect Identification → Correction → Retesting → Final Evaluation

Regression testing was conducted after corrections and system modifications to determine whether previously functioning features remained operational.
